title: Kiss Him, Not Me
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kae Serinuma is a fujoshi who loves imagining romances between boys. When her favorite anime character dies, the shock makes her lose a great deal of weight, and suddenly four of the most attractive boys at school want to date her, though she would much rather see them date each other. The comedy follows her group dates and friendships as she navigates sudden popularity.
life_message: Friends who like you for who you are matter more than looks, and being yourself, hobbies and all, is worth keeping.
